newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan's CPC cuts 4th cracker output by 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC cuts 4th cracker output by 10 pct.

text.p: Taiwan state-run Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) said on Thursday it had cut the production of its fourth naphtha cracker by about 10 percent to reduce inventories.
The fourth cracker in southern Kaohsiung has an annual production capacity of 385,000 tonnes of ethylene.
"We have reduced the fourth cracker's output by about 10 percent to lower inventories," an official at Chinese Petroleum's Kaohsiung refinery said by telephone.
Chinese Petroleum currently has about 1.2 million pounds of ethylene in inventory, the official said.
He declined to give further details.
China Manmade, Formosa Plastics, USI Far East and Lee Chang Yung Chemical Industrial Corp are Taiwan's main ethylene users.
Chinese Petroleum's third naphtha cracker has an annual production capacity of 230,000 tonnes of ethylene and the fifth naphtha cracker has an annual capacity of 400,000 tonnes.
